Nasdaq Leads Stocks Lower as Dollar Retreats Before Central Bank Bonanza
Published The Money Makers Club now has 6 of 15 available seats. Learn more here!
Friday’s sudden negative shift continued to define trading so far today, with the weakness in the Nasdaq and especially the market-leading tech giants is driving returns. The major US indices opened with losses, with the Dow and the S&P 500 clearly outperforming the tech benchmark, reversing the relationship that dominated the market for months. Nasdaq 100 Futures, 4-Hour Chart Analysis
Facebook (FB), which quickly turned into huge drag following its disappointing guidance, is down by 4% today, Netflix (NFLX) is also under pressure, and the other FANG stocks, Google parent Alphabet (GOOG) and Amazon (AMZN), and Apple (AAPL) are also in the red, even as Apple is yet to publish its quarterly numbers, while Amazon and Google released decent reports. Should the momentum leaders of the recent US rally lose their mojo, the already fragile foundation of the rally will receive another hit. FB, 4-Hour Chart Analysis
The largest public company, Apple is scheduled to release its earnings report tomorrow after the closing bell, and all eyes will be on the firm’s margins and its services segment. Apple is trying to deal with the fact that its main product, the iPhone is facing a maturing market with fierce competition, and its push to monetize its unparalleled ecosystem will be crucial to keep growing.
With the company’s record share in the largest indices, the earnings report will be huge for the whole market, and a positive guidance could stop the Nasdaq’s correction, while a disappointing report could trigger a deeper correction across the board. Apple, Daily Chart Analysis
European and Asian stocks, which also lagged the market-leading US tech segment are also performing slightly better today, but from a longer-term perspective, they are still clearly on the weak side. The deep divergences that made us cautious in recent weeks are still present, and given the hostile valuation levels in the US and the Dollar-funding woes in emerging markets, we remain defensive regarding stocks here. DAX Index, 4-Hour Chart Analysis Central Banks in Focus as BOJ Intervenes
The Bank of Japan stepped in to prop up government bonds yet again overnight as the recent rumors of a possible policy change triggered a rise in yields that spooked the central bank. Monetary policy will be in the center of attention throughout the week and across the globe, with the Federal Reserve and Bank of England holding meeting s beside the BOJ scheduled gathering. Dollar Index, 4-Hour Chart Analysis
The Dollar and the Yen were both sold compared to the other major today, with especially the Euro being pushed higher, despite the risk-off day in stocks. With the Dollar index still trading in a choppy range, hard-to-trade conditions will likely persist in forex markets in the coming eventful days, until a clear momentum move out of the pattern.
While the general picture in the most traded commodities is unchanged today, the weakness in the Dollar sparked a rebound-rally in crude oil and gold after Friday’s slump, while copper reversed its early losses too. The WTI crude contract is just above the key $70 per barrel level, gold is slightly over the $1230 level, while copper is holding on above the $2.75 level, for now.

Published The Money Makers Club now has 6 of 15 available seats. Learn more here!
The major cryptocurrencies are sporting small losses today, after a low-volume, low volatility weekend that saw no changes in the technical picture. The main focus continues to be on Bitcoin, as the largest coin is still the most bullish among the crucial coins. The short-term relative strength of BTC remained apparent in the last few days, as despite the late-Thursday selloff, Bitcoin is back near the $8200 level after falling as low as the $7800 support/ resistance level.
While BTC is close to triggering a short-term buy signal, altcoins are still overwhelmingly bearish, as nor ETH or XRP managed to follow Bitcoin higher, and now both of them are drifting lower together with the broader market. The lack of a clear leadership beside BTC is still a negative sign for crypto-bulls, and our trend model is also showing short-term sell signals across the board, as no technical progress has been made for more than a month. BTC/USD, 4-Hour Chart Analysis
Bitcoin remains in an encouraging short-term technical setup, in the face of the altcoin weakness, and now, the overbought momentum readings are fully cleared, with the coin safely holding up above the $7650-$7800. That said, the correction is still ongoing with BTC still being on a neutral short-term signal, and another test of the zone is possible, even if the coin will experience another leg higher. Further support is found at $7350 and $7000, while resistance is ahead at $8400 and $8700. Still No Follow-Through Among Altcoins NEO/USDT, 4-Hour Chart Analysis
On another negative note, while we have seen bullish bursts higher in recent weeks, like in the case of NEO, Monero, and Dash (with Stellar also losing momentum lately), the altocins that have been showing some strength all gave back most of their gains. The lack of follow-through, together with the lack of leadership means that most of the altcoins will likely test their June lows in the coming weeks. ETH/USD, 4-Hour Chart Analysis
All rally attempts in Ethereum have been sold in recent weeks, confirming the coin’s relative weakness, and as the previously weak coins also failed to gather strength, the declining trend remains dominant. ETH is trading back below the $475 level, and although the $450 support is still holding on, a test of the $400-$420 level is very likely in the coming period.
Our trend model is on a short-term sell signal, despite the still favorable long-term setup and traders shouldn’t enter new positions here. Further support is found at $380 and $360, while resistance is ahead at $500 and between $555 and $575. XRP/USD, 4-Hour Chart Analysis
Ripple has been stuck in a narrow range for days, with the $0.45 level still being in the center of attention. The coin is still just above the key long-term zone near $0.42, and the persistent relative weakness points to, at least, a re-test in the coming week. Key resistance is ahead near $0.51, with a weaker level at $0.49.

Crypto Update: Why TRON Deserves Your Attention
Published The Money Makers Club now has 6 of 15 available seats. Learn more here!
While plenty of eyes in the cryptocurrency world are fixated on what Bitcoin will do next, TRON (TRX/USD) has been busy making moves. From the low of 0.0312 on July 12, the pair is up by almost 20% as of this writing. The growth in such a short period of time is impressive. However, what matters more is the significance of the moves behind that growth.
In this article, we reveal why TRON deserves your attention. Tron Bullish in Shorter Time Frames
The “Smart Money” usually shows their hand when they expect that no one’s watching. While most people were having their weekend, TRON broke out of a symmetrical triangle formation on the 4-hour and the 1-hour chart with heavy volume.
4-hour chart of TRX/USD
The series of higher lows put so much pressure on the resistance that it snapped. On top of that, the 4-day, 8-day, and 21-day moving averages (MA) converge below the candle’s body. They will act as support levels that would help drive the market up. Bullish in the Daily
In addition to the breakout in the hourly charts, TRON has also managed to break out of the falling wedge that has kept the market bearish for over two months. The bullish price action was driven by oversold conditions.
Daily chart of TRX/USD
On top of that, the RSI also broke out of a small triple bottom pattern. The market is now using the former resistance of 40 as a firm support. This tells us that TRON is gathering significant bullish momentum.
Furthermore, the three MAs are lining up below the daily candle’s body. At the height of the bear run, these MAs functioned as resistance levels. They are often on top of the candle’s body, preventing upward movement. This time around, they will help prevent downward movement. Bullish in the Weekly
If you’re a long-term investor, this last point should convince you the reason that TRON deserves your attention. A look at the weekly chart shows that TRON has also broken out of a falling wedge. What’s more important, however, is that the pair has established 0.03 as its bottom. Bulls are jumping at the chance to buy at this level.
Weekly Chart of TRX/USD
This knowledge is one of the reasons why TRON is breaking out from bullish reversal patterns. Participants are starting to feel the urgency to buy as close to 0.03 as possible. The fear of missing out appears to drive the higher low setups in the lower time frames.
In the end, many bottom fishers are playing for the grand prize. The possibility of a large double bottom pattern.
The recent bullish price actions make this situation plausible. Bottom Line
While many investors are looking at Bitcoin’s activity, there are strong arguments that TRON deserves your attention. These arguments involve TRON breaking out from bullish reversal patterns on the hourly and the daily charts. Best of all, TRON offers the possibility of a double bottom pattern on the weekly chart.
